statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security and privacy lead and PCI DSS contact
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with an outside review at least every second year
Annual policy review
PCI scope description; sign an SAQ only when every eligibility criterion is true, with evidence
Contractor breaches handled under their terms; same-day access removal
Written, time-limited exceptions; never for card data
Provider list with PCI DSS responsibilities; annual AOC and SOC 2 check
Contractor terms: confidentiality, data use, deletion, 24-hour incident notice
Contractors acknowledge acceptable use rules before access
Owner-started, watched remote support
Named accounts; no shared credentials
MFA on every account that offers it
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager; defaults changed
Least-privilege contractor roles; same-day removal; quarterly user and connected-app review
Device lock after 5 minutes (phones 1 minute)
Sealed emergency access codes held by the owner's attorney
Monthly and post-on-sale review of SYS-01, website, and email activity
Change log; approved script list; monthly check of pages that embed the checkout
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS 6.5; SAQ A script eligibility criterion)

statement_summary: Three-level data classification
Patron records only in approved systems
Never accept, write, key, or keep card data; payment links; delete on receipt
No card data or exports by message; no public share links
Full-disk encryption and passcodes on every device
Keep only the latest export; erase on disposal; wipe old devices
Keep security records 3 years and breach determinations 5 years
Updates, antivirus, setup checklist
Separate business and guest Wi-Fi; password never posted
AI tools only after assessment; no patron data in consumer AI; smart pricing suggest-only with caps and accessible seating parity
Total price in every advertisement; limits and privacy notice match practice
Annual security course; contractor briefing
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Notify the processor within 24 hours of suspected card data compromise; preserve evidence
Meet notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom or extortion payment without counsel and an OFAC check
Attendee list downloaded and printed before doors
Show-night card and backup promoter arrangement
